pages.text: Return true when every child condition is true, combining spatial or expression requirements.

pages.title: Default Mana Cost
pages.text: 0. Any nested spatial searches keep their own costs.$(br2)See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l) for the calculation rules.

pages.title: Structural Complexity
pages.text: 0.1 plus attached conditions and modifiers, counted as structure rather than per test.$(br2)Combine complexity, then apply 5+10*C+0.625*C^2 for total focus. See $(l:modularmagic:resource_costs)Focus and Mana$(/l).
